The sworn translator George Wilhelm Behr certifies that the foregoing translation agrees word for word with the Polish original extract.

Document 16 records that the contract made ueber diese zehn Hufen unterm 26ten May c. a. durch einen gewissen Kunkel was handed back and gaenzlich aufgehoben und annolliret. Document 17 is that Kunkel contract, dated 26 May 1804.

Document 21 is conditional throughout on der Kauf mit den Honrichs annulirt worden; document 2 is the Kauf-Punctation to Martin Honrichs over the same estate Witow. It replaces it only once that annulment takes effect.
Covering rescript of the same day: Ew. Liebden erhalten beiliegend eine Ausfertigung des ... dato confirmirten Kauf-Contracts.
The confirmation names den Kauf-Contract vom 16/25. Januar 1805; document 4 is that contract, subscribed Breslau den 16ten Januar 1805.

The Krieges- und Domainen-Cammer returns the submitted Erbpachts-Contract and declares the Vererbpachtung of the Herrschaft Betsche to its Buergerschaft ganz unzulaessig. Document 18 is that contract.
